card.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
card.officialText: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

scope: Discord 2v2 integration regression for an already certified card; no new admission or certification.
behaviors: Uses handleTagComponent → tagStore.actTag → tagDuel/duelEngine; does not call stepTagDuel directly for the action under test.
The active physical seat can target a teammate-owned or opponent-owned card in either shared team backrow.
A face-down target's UID, card ID and name are absent from the public panel before activation.
The inactive teammate cannot submit the team's action.
Exactly the selected target moves to the opposing team's shared Graveyard with its original UID and card ID; other backrow cards remain.
The resolving Mystical Space Typhoon moves to its controller team's shared Graveyard; its effect does not negate the target's activation.
All four private hands, all 120 Main Deck UIDs/identities, and all four Extra Decks are conserved except the source leaving the active player's hand for the Graveyard.
Discord public/private payload builders pass validateDiscordPayload.
Persistent players and player_cards tables remain byte-for-byte equivalent before and after the borrowed duel.
limitations: Discord is exercised offline through the production component handler, store, duel engine and payload builders; no live guild/token is used.
This is an integration regression for an already certified card, not a new card certification.
The test uses temporary SQLite and borrowed NPC decks; persistent player inventory is not modified.
